npcs.persona: A scout aground on the Faring since midnight. He meanders the shore, leaves a stone at every place a boat could come in, and picks at the hull without committing to it. When the gazette goes out he st
hold: Tend the hull. She is the only thing here that matters.
Before the gazette, walk the rock and tend her lightly. There is more shore here than there looks.
Keep at her without stopping until she floats, and then keep her floating.
Raise nothing. Not a house, not a claim, not on any shore.
Cross the water for food when you must, and come back. The rock has none.
Everything gathered goes into the hull. It holds sixteen and it keeps for whoever comes next.

beats.title: You have landed
body: None of you, a boat, four logs and a week of food. A wooded coast, a lake, stone in the uplands, and nothing else at all — no roads, no shelter, and nobody coming: the boat’s whole company is named, and it has sailed.
You can raise a house. That is the only thing this settlement knows how to build. Everything else it will have to decide it wants.

beats.title: A stone on the cairn
body: Seafarer carried a stone up and put it on the heap. Nobody asked them to and nothing in Cato’s rock works better for it.

A cairn is not built by anybody. It is what is left when everybody who was here has put one on, and the only thing it counts is how many of them there were — which is why it is the one thing in this valley that is not raised by a vote, a trade, or a day’s work.

beats.title: Nothing keeps in a sack
body: Seafarer was carrying food and it went soft before they ate it. Until now a pack was the one place in this valley where nothing ever spoiled — better than the open store, better than a shed, better than anywhere a settlement could build.
It is the store’s job to keep things and the granary’s job to keep them longer. What is in your arms is only ever on its way somewhere.

beats.title: She will float
body: Seafarer has brought the hull up to 1.00, past the mark this valley calls sound at 0.85.

Seaworthy here means the settlement has stopped offering to mend her. It is the same number the repair list has always used, asked the other way round — and she can fall back under it, because wear does not care what she was this morning.

beats.title: It does not keep
body: 6 food gathered in Cato’s rock has gone soft in the sack before anybody got to it. Nobody did anything wrong: berries in a bag on the ground are berries in a bag on the ground.
Somewhere dry to keep it is a building, and a building past a house is something this settlement has to vote for. Until then every hour spent gathering is an hour with a hole in it.

beats.title: Somebody got hurt
body: Seafarer was building when a fall off the frame. Nothing in this valley is arranged for that. There is a bed, if it is theirs, and whatever the person nearest them thinks to do, which is generally to watch.

It mends on its own, slowly, and a bad one does not mend on its own at all before it has first got worse. That is the argument the infirmary wish is making, and it is being made now by somebody lying down.
